product_family: AI Studios: all-in-one AI video generation, avatar creation, video translation/dubbing, and conversational AI avatar platform. Key products: AI Studios (video), AI Human (conversational avatars), AI Detector (deepfake detection). Serves 2M+ users globally across content creators, enterprises, and Fortune 500 companies.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: SOC 2 Type II compliant. The platform meets the highest standards for data protection, risk reduction, and operational integrity.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: ISO 27001 certified. ISO 27001-compliant security framework protects information through world-class risk management practices.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: GDPR compliant. AI Studios maintains compliance with EU data protection regulations, ensuring secure and transparent data handling. EU representative appointed under GDPR Article 27.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA-compliant deployment available (Enterprise). Platform provides HIPAA-compliant deployment for enterprise users who need to handle healthcare data.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP certification on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: DeepBrain AI explicitly states customer data never trains their AI models. Third-party AI providers (Stripe, AWS, HubSpot, Intercom) are used for various services with data processing agreements. Company takes reasonable steps to ensure third-party providers handle personal information safely and in accordance with GDPR/applicable data protection standards.
privacy.data_region: Multiple options available: EU, US, APAC. Personal data transfers to: United States (Stripe, HubSpot, Intercom, AWS), Germany & South Korea (AWS backup). Data residency configurable for enterprise customers.

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: Encrypted data transfer with secure protocols implemented

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES-256 end-to-end encryption mentioned for Enterprise deployments

security.name: Access Control
security.value: Role-based access control (RBAC) with IP restrictions available

security.name: Audit Logging
security.value: Audit logging for every interaction with 5-year retention for generation logs

security.name: Content Authenticity
security.value: Member of Content Authenticity Initiative (CAI), pledges to uphold AI content integrity and combat misinformation

products.name: AI Studios (Video)
products.data_scope: User-uploaded scripts, images, video clips, documents (PDFs, PPTs, Word). Customer data is NOT used for model training.
products.notes: Core product: text-to-video, video dubbing/translation (150+ languages), avatar creation (2000+ ready-made + custom), SCORM-compatible course builder, interactive video with quizzes. Free tier available with limited credits; paid tiers unlock higher limits.

products.name: AI Human (Avatars)
products.data_scope: Voice, text inputs for conversational interactions. Can be customized with company documents for on-brand responses.
products.notes: Real-time conversational avatars for customer service, sales, training (150+ languages, 1000+ voices). Supports integration with OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, and custom LLMs. Multi-channel deployment (web, mobile, kiosk, WhatsApp). Enterprise HIPAA deployment available.

products.name: AI Detector
products.data_scope: URLs or images submitted for deepfake detection analysis
products.notes: Deepfake detection tool with 24/7 monitoring and alerting. Certified for ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR, and ISO 42001. Provides impact reports and trend analysis.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium (free tier with limited credits) + tiered subscriptions (Personal, Team, Enterprise). Generative Credits for select features (AI Images, Generative Video, Avatar creation). Additional credit packs purchasable.
compare.data_residency: Multi-region: EU, US, APAC available. Configurable for enterprise customers.
